title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 116
paragraphs: The young men agreed to this also, and they crossed the Tanaïs and journeyed towards the rising sun for three days' journey from the Tanaïs, and also towards the north wind for three days' journey from the Maeotian lake. Having arrived at the place where they are now settled, they took up their abode there. From that time onward, the women of the Sauromatai practise their ancient way of living, going out regularly on horseback to the chase, both in the company of the men and apart from them, going regularly to war, and wearing the same dress as the men.
